CREATE TABLE findings (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	asset_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	type VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	dedup_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	remediation TEXT NOT NULL, 
	severity VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	scanner_severity VARCHAR(10), 
	severity_override VARCHAR(10), 
	cvss_score FLOAT, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	cwe VARCHAR(20)[] NOT NULL, 
	rule_id VARCHAR(300), 
	tools VARCHAR(100)[] NOT NULL, 
	file_path VARCHAR(1000), 
	line_start INTEGER, 
	line_end INTEGER, 
	snippet TEXT, 
	package_name VARCHAR(300), 
	package_version VARCHAR(100), 
	ecosystem VARCHAR(50), 
	purl VARCHAR(1000), 
	cve_id VARCHAR(50), 
	vuln_id VARCHAR(100), 
	fixed_version VARCHAR(200), 
	"references" JSONB NOT NULL, 
	resource VARCHAR(500), 
	url VARCHAR(2000), 
	http_method VARCHAR(10), 
	parameter VARCHAR(300), 
	first_seen_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	last_seen_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	closed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	first_scan_id INTEGER, 
	last_scan_id INTEGER, 
	assignee_id INTEGER, 
	status_justification TEXT, 
	risk_accepted_until TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	due_at_override TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	sla_breach_due TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	acceptance_warned_until TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	tags VARCHAR(64)[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, 
	occurrence_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	fingerprint VARCHAR(200), 
	search_vector TSVECTOR GENERATED ALWAYS AS (setweight(to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(title, '')), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(cve_id, '') || ' ' || coalesce(vuln_id, '') || ' ' || coalesce(rule_id, '') || ' ' || coalesce(package_name, '')), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(file_path, '')), 'B') || setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(description, '')), 'C')) STORED NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_findings_asset_dedup UNIQUE (asset_id, dedup_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(asset_id) REFERENCES assets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(first_scan_id) REFERENCES scans (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(last_scan_id) REFERENCES scans (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(assignee_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
